meta.title: Japan Rate Normalization Shock Thesis — April 2026
meta.claim: BoJ exits ZIRP/YCC → USD/JPY-funded carry collapses → JGB yields spike → Japanese lifers repatriate ~$1.1T of US duration → long-end Treasuries sell off → equity multiples compress → mega-cap tech (the carry beneficiaries) leads down. Trade the unwind, not the headline.

nodes.label: BoJ Policy Decision
nodes.context: BoJ ended NIRP March 2024 and dismantled YCC formally July 2024; policy rate currently 0.50% (Jan 2026 hike). Next MPM Apr 30–May 1, 2026. Ueda has signaled policy normalization continues if wage-inflation spiral confirms. A 25bp hike to 0.75% is the catalyst the carry trade is positioned against.
nodes._calendarFeedComment: calendarFeed pins this deadline node to a specific upcoming event in the econ calendar connector (tools/data_fetch/econ_calendar.py). When the connector runs, it overlays the live event date onto countdown math — keeping the node fresh without manual edits. event_id format follows the connector's stable slug scheme; rotate to the next BoJ MPM after each meeting.

nodes.label: JGB 10Y Yield
nodes.context: JGB 10Y at ~1.45%, the highest since 2009 and a 35-year regime break. 1.50% is the psychological line; 1.75% is where lifer ALM models flip from 'extend duration overseas' to 'repatriate'. Calibration TBD beyond 2.00% — no modern data.

nodes.label: USD/JPY Carry Pair
nodes.context: USD/JPY at 152.4. The pair IS the carry trade — short JPY funded longs in everything from EM equity to BTC to 7 Mag-7 names. Below 145 = carry IRR turns negative for most reset-quarterly books. Aug 2024 unwind happened in 3 sessions when the pair dropped from 162 → 142.

nodes.label: JPY Carry Unwind
nodes.context: BIS estimates the global JPY carry book at ~$1T notional, with another ~$3T in JPY-denominated cross-border bank claims that behave similarly. The 'event' fires when USD/JPY breaks the carry-IRR line and prime brokers issue first margin calls. Aug 5, 2024 was the warning shot — Nikkei -12% in one session.

nodes.label: Japan Lifer Repatriation
nodes.context: Japanese life insurers + GPIF hold ~$1.1T in foreign bonds, ~70% USTs. Once domestic JGB yields > FX-hedged UST yield (currency-hedged 10Y UST currently ~0.8%), ALM mandates flip to net repatriation. The unwind is mechanical, not discretionary — it happens at fiscal-year boundaries (March, September).

nodes.label: US 10Y Treasury Yield
nodes.context: US 10Y at 4.35%. Lifer repatriation removes a structural bid that has compressed term premium for a decade. Estimated +30 to +60bps shock to 10Y if even 10% of the $1.1T book rotates home. Above 5% breaks every duration-sensitive trade in the system.

nodes.label: MOVE (Rates Vol)
nodes.context: MOVE at 95. Rates vol is the canary. Above 130 = prime brokers double haircuts on duration collateral; above 150 = forced de-grossing. MOVE > 130 has preceded every credit event since 2020 (SVB, gilts, regional banks).

nodes.label: Mega-Cap Tech Breakdown
nodes.context: XLK at 245. Mega-cap tech is the single biggest carry beneficiary — long-duration cash flows discounted at compressed real rates, plus passive flow buoyancy from carry-funded EM allocations. A 10Y move from 4.35% to 5.00% mathematically compresses NDX multiples 8–12%.

nodes.label: Equity Vol Spike
nodes.context: VIX at 17. A real carry unwind drives VIX > 30 (Aug-2024 spiked to 65 intraday). Confluence node: requires both rates-vol AND tech breakdown to confirm — either alone can be a head-fake.

nodes.label: Prime Broker Margin Calls
nodes.context: Once MOVE > 130 AND USD/JPY < 145, prime brokers raise haircuts on JPY-funded books. Multi-strat pods with VaR breaches must de-gross same-day. This is the amplification channel — forced sellers create the air pocket the thesis trades.

nodes.label: Fed Reaction Function
nodes.context: If Fed cuts to absorb the duration sell-off, the trade caps. If Fed stays restrictive (current dot plot: 1 cut 2026), the unwind runs unchecked. Powell's reaction function vs. financial stability is the binary that separates 'controlled exit' from 'flash unwind'. Calibration TBD on Fed put strike.
nodes.condition: Fed signals emergency cut OR maintains restrictive stance

nodes.label: BoJ Slows Normalization
nodes.context: If BoJ pauses hikes or signals YCC-redux to calm JGB market, the entire chain stalls. MoF FX intervention is the secondary lever — they bought ~9.8T yen defending USD/JPY in 2024. Watch Kanda/Mimura statements for verbal intervention warnings.
nodes.condition: BoJ pauses hikes OR MoF intervenes in FX market

nodes.label: Nikkei / Hedged Japan Equity Divergence
nodes.context: Nikkei is short-yen-correlated: USD/JPY rallies = Nikkei rallies (export earnings translation). Carry unwind reverses this. DXJ (currency-hedged) underperforms unhedged EWJ by 8–15pp in a yen-rally regime. The pair trade is short DXJ / long FXY.

nodes.label: New ¥¥¥ Equilibrium
nodes.context: Two resolution paths: (a) 'controlled' — USD/JPY stabilizes 138–145, JGB 10Y settles 1.5–1.75%, US 10Y at 4.5%, tech rebases lower with new multiples. (b) 'persistent risk-off' — carry book takes 12+ months to fully unwind, vol regime change. Trigger: VIX < 18 for 5 closes AND USD/JPY range-bound for 4 weeks.
nodes.action: Cut FXY 1/2, close TLT short, trim VIX calls, rebuild SGOV

edges.mechanism: 25bp hike repriced across the JGB curve; 5Y–10Y segment most sensitive (duration ~7y * 25bp ≈ +1.7% price impact propagates as +20–30bp yield)
Rate differential narrows: each 25bp BoJ hike with no Fed move shrinks UST-JGB 10Y spread ~25bp, mechanically pulling USD/JPY ~3 figures lower at full pass-through
Once JGB 10Y > FX-hedged UST 10Y (~0.8% currently), lifer ALM mandates flip from net foreign accumulation to net repatriation — the threshold is roughly 1.75% on JGB 10Y
Sub-145 pushes carry-IRR negative for quarterly-reset books; sub-140 triggers programmatic unwind as VaR limits breach across funds running 5x+ leverage on the trade
Yen rally crushes Nikkei translation earnings; foreign holders (record 31%) exit JPY-hedged share classes first — DXJ underperforms EWJ by 8–15pp in unwind regimes
Carry collapse forces lifer hedging desks to roll FX hedges at worse levels, accelerating the math on currency-hedged UST holdings being unprofitable
$1.1T foreign bond book; even 10% rotation = $110B of UST selling concentrated in 10Y–30Y. Term premium estimated to repricе +30 to +60bps
Sustained UST sell-off drives realized vol higher; MOVE tracks 1m at-the-money straddle on 5Y/10Y/30Y — a +50bp 10Y move in 4 weeks pushes MOVE from 95 → 130+
DCF math: 10Y at 5.0% vs. 4.35% compresses NDX terminal-value multiples 8–12% holding earnings constant; long-duration cash flows (Mag-7) hit hardest
MOVE > 130 triggers prime broker collateral haircut increases; multi-strat pods with VaR breaches must de-gross same-day — forced selling cascades
JPY-funded books across multi-strats face VaR breaches as the funding-leg rallies; haircuts reset and forced de-grossing follows within sessions
Mega-cap tech is ~30% of S&P; a 10% drawdown in XLK mathematically pushes SPX -3% which historically pushes VIX from 17 → 28+
Cross-asset vol contagion: rates vol leads equity vol in carry-unwind regimes (2018, Aug 2024)
Forced de-grossing across multi-strat books realizes vol; gamma-short dealer hedging amplifies into closing prints
VIX > 30 sustained AND credit spreads widening forces Fed to balance financial stability vs inflation mandate; emergency cut or facility extension becomes plausible
Vol mean-reversion is the resolution signal; VIX < 18 for 5 closes AND a stable USD/JPY range marks new equilibrium
Fed put activation caps the unwind; without it, the chain runs to natural carry-book exhaustion (12+ months)

scenarios.name: Controlled BoJ exit
scenarios.notes: BoJ hikes 25bp on schedule, signals 'gradual'. JGB 10Y settles 1.50–1.65%. USD/JPY drifts to 145–148. Carry unwinds in slow motion over 6 months. US 10Y rises modestly to 4.50–4.65%. Tech wobbles -5–8% then stabilizes.

scenarios.name: BoJ surprise hike (50bp)
scenarios.notes: BoJ delivers 50bp hike citing wage-spiral confirmation. JGB 10Y > 1.85%. USD/JPY breaks 142. Lifer repatriation triggered immediately. US 10Y to 4.85%. Tech drawdown 12–18%. MOVE breaks 130.

scenarios.name: Carry flash unwind (Aug-2024 redux)
scenarios.notes: USD/JPY drops 10+ figures in <5 sessions. Margin calls cascade. MOVE > 150. VIX spikes through 50. Tech -25%+. Multi-strat de-grossing peaks. The thesis-defining tail event.

scenarios.name: Fed cuts to absorb
scenarios.notes: Powell pivots: 50bp emergency cut + balance sheet expansion to absorb UST supply shock. Trade caps. USD/JPY rebounds to 148. Tech multiple expansion resumes. Real rates collapse — gold breaks out.

rules: Review 3x/week: Tuesday close (post-MoF flow data), Friday close (CFTC COT), Sunday evening (Asia open prep).
Never deploy > 1/3 SGOV on a single signal. Reserve budget: $1,000/month.
VXX is a tactical sleeve, not a hold: Trim aggressively into spikes (sell vol when others are panicking). Decay is the enemy.
BoJ MPM dates are the only fixed catalysts: April 30 – May 1, June 16-17, July 30-31. Don't add risk in the 48h before MPM — wait for the print.
Asymmetric kill-switch: If Fed signals emergency cut, close TLT/TBT short same session — thesis violated.
Don't fight MoF FX intervention: Verbal warnings (Kanda/Mimura) reduce FXY size 1/3 immediately; actual intervention — close half.
Confluence rule: vix-spike fires only when MOVE>130 AND tech-breakdown<220 — either alone is a head-fake.
Graph propagation: When USD/JPY breaks 145, expect lifer-repatriation to lag 4–8 weeks before US 10Y feels it.
Analog calibration: Aug 2024 unwind ran in 5 sessions and reversed in 3 weeks — the 2026 setup is structurally larger because rate diff is now narrowing not just stable.
Resolution discipline: Don't reverse the trade until VIX<18 for 5 closes AND USD/JPY 4-week range <4 figures. Premature exit = re-entry at worse levels.

provenance.methodology: Causal DAG modeling the BoJ-normalization → carry-unwind → US-duration → tech-multiple-compression chain. Edge strengths are subjective conditional probabilities calibrated against the August 2024 mini-unwind (full pass-through observed in 5 sessions) and the 2018 VIXmageddon precedent (rate-vol → equity-vol contagion). Lifer repatriation modeled as a structural ALM threshold rather than a discretionary flow — the trigger is JGB 10Y > FX-hedged UST 10Y, currently calibrated at ~1.75% on JGB 10Y. Multi-strat margin-call channel is the primary amplifier; without it the unwind is slow-motion, with it it is the August-2024 redux.
limitations: BoJ reaction function below NIRP-exit is largely untested — Ueda regime has limited public history on hike pacing.
Lifer foreign-bond holdings reported with 4–8 week lag (MoF); actual repatriation may be observable only after the fact.
Aug 2024 analog ran 5 sessions; structural unwind could run quarters — lag estimates are wide.
MoF FX intervention is undeclared until after-the-fact — always a tape-watching trade not a data-driven one.
Edge strengths calibrated against single-precedent (Aug 2024) — sample size = 1.
Fed reaction function vs financial stability is the unknown — Powell has not been tested in a yen-led shock.
Tech multiple-compression math assumes earnings constant — actual print may show simultaneous EPS hits.
No Polymarket prediction market currently mapped to BoJ-specific events — monitoring for emergence.
provenance.disclaimer: Research framework for structured expert judgment, not financial advice. The math enforces consistency — it does not generate predictions. This thesis runs alongside Iran/Hormuz and Trump-tariffs — a simultaneous yen-led carry unwind during an oil shock or tariff escalation would create stagflation tail risk not modeled here.

analogs.name: August 2024 Carry Unwind
lessons: Carry unwinds happen in sessions, not months — 5 sessions cleared most of the disorderly de-grossing.
VIX mean-reverted in 3 weeks — vol shorts caught the bid back.
Multi-strat de-grossing was the amplifier, not the cause — the cause was BoJ hike + FX intervention combo.
Fed verbal intervention (no actual cut) was sufficient to backstop — Fed put exists at lower strike than people think.
Tech (NDX -6.4%) recovered fastest — the 'multiple compression' trade was a head-fake without sustained UST sell-off.
analogs.notes: Aug 5 2024: BoJ surprise hike + MoF FX intervention combo broke USD/JPY from 162 → 142 in 5 sessions. Nikkei -12% in one day. VIX 17 → 65. Multi-strat de-grossing was visible. The 2026 setup differs: rate differential is structurally narrowing (not stable), so the equilibrium reset is larger.

analogs.name: February 2018 Volmageddon
lessons: Short-vol structures fail nonlinearly — VXX inverse products died in one session.
Cross-asset vol contagion: rates vol (which rose first) led equity vol.
Recovery was slow (6 weeks) — vol regime change persisted longer than the price action.
The trade was to be long vol BEFORE the spike, not chase it after.
analogs.notes: Cross-asset vol mechanics analog. Rates vol rising first foreshadowed the equity event. The 2026 thesis MOVE>130 trigger is calibrated against this template.
